name: Nervous Twitch
text: Your Stress and every friendly PC's within SHORT range rises by one.

effects.text: +1 Stress to you and friendly PCs in SHORT range.

name: Tremble
text: Uncontrollable shaking: -2 to all AGILITY-based rolls until the panic ends.

effects.text: -2 to AGILITY-based skill rolls until panic stops.

name: Drop Item
text: You drop a weapon or other key item (GM picks) and gain +1 Stress.

name: Freeze
text: Frozen for a Round: you lose your next slow action, and you and friendly PCs in SHORT range gain +1 Stress.

effects.text: +1 Stress to you and friendly PCs in SHORT range.

name: Seek Cover
text: Your next action must be moving to safety (retreat roll allowed if ENGAGED). You lose 1 Stress but friendly PCs in SHORT range gain 1. Normal after one Round.

effects.text: Next action: move away to cover.
+1 Stress to friendly PCs in SHORT range.

name: Scream
text: You scream for a Round, losing your next slow action. You lose 1 Stress, but every friendly character who hears it must make a Panic Roll.

effects.text: Lose next slow action; friendlies who hear must roll for panic.

name: Flee
text: You run to a safe place and refuse to leave; no attacks, nothing dangerous; no retreat roll if ENGAGED. You lose 1 Stress; every friendly character who sees you run must make a Panic Roll.

effects.text: Flee and stay in safety; watchers roll for panic.

name: Berserk
text: You attack the nearest person or creature, friend or foe, until you or it is Broken. Friendly witnesses must make a Panic Roll.

effects.text: Must attack nearest target until someone is Broken; witnesses roll for panic.

name: Catatonic
text: You collapse, unable to move or speak, staring into nothing.
